item.description: 경품: Ten winners each get a place on a 30-minute group video call with Lukas Podolski in the week of December 15–19, 2026 (ARV $500 each, $5,000 total). 마감일: 2026년 12월 1일. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl.
